scope: Read-only terminal mesh-cache plan review; original deform remains authority
working_tree_note: Current root working tree still contains a prepared-charger formula candidate. That duplication is explicitly excluded from this proposed review; root intends restoring original deform plus two zero-weight returns and a small terminal cache.
eligibility: dead && raw death>=1 && landing==0, with one current mesh cache per Skin instance

flora_dependency_conclusion.sentry: Dead branch uses only point/uv/size/clamped death; returns before live clock variables. At clamped death1 no pose clock/drive/turn/air dependence.
flora_dependency_conclusion.fan_sentry: Dead branch returns at d>=1 before reading death_clock or recursing into captured live deformation. Static pre-fit depends only kind/uv/size/point.
flora_dependency_conclusion.root_bell: Dead branch uses only point/uv/size/clamped death and stem geometry; returns before live variables.
flora_dependency_conclusion.outer_clamp: With dead=true and death>=1, Flora outer floor clamp executes independently of air. Skin landing offset is zero by eligibility.

ground_dependency_conclusion.mathematical: All three dead targets depend only point/uv/size/clamped death and become constant at1.
ground_dependency_conclusion.exact_float_caveat: Ground still evaluates live deformation and vitality then p.lerp(target,1). A mathematical identity does not by itself prove float32 byte independence. Full625 vertex bit comparisons across varied captured poses/air are required before omitting these inputs from an exact-equivalence cache key. Reviewer did not execute that engine experiment.
ground_dependency_conclusion.support_loss: Finished corpse may retain death1 while air changes false→true after support loss. This is a necessary Ground key/regression case until exact independence is demonstrated.
